title: Your head ages faster than your feet
hook: Your head is ticking faster than your feet right now.
script: Your feet are stuck in the past. Your head ages faster, because the higher you are, the weaker gravity pulls. So why does standing up make your head tick faster than your feet? Atomic clocks, raised just 33 centimetres apart, proved this time warp. Here’s how: weaker gravity at your head makes time flow slightly quicker. The effect is tiny—about 90 billionths of a second over 80 years—but it’s real. So if you lay flat forever, your head and feet would age almost in sync. GPS satellites orbit so high they’d be useless without correcting for this same bend.
